method: Requirements recorded from archived Oracle and published rulings before this assignment inspects native definitions or author test explanations. Same agent authored earlier batch: prior familiarity cannot be erased; this is source-first agent review, not blind or independent human certification. Requirement versions are preserved in Git. Mutation labels will not be inputs to assertion helpers.

cards.name: Planewide Celebration
cards.selectionReason: Assignment risk sample across both batches; Tatterkite lower-complexity control

requirements.claim: Choose exactly four modes with repetition; instructions execute in printed order, regardless of selection order.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Choose life before return/token; inspect resolution order.

requirements.claim: Return mode targets a permanent card in your own graveyard and moves it to hand, not battlefield; targets belong to each mode occurrence.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Opponent graveyard or nonpermanent invalid; repeated targets share legal-target rules.

requirements.claim: If every chosen target is illegal the whole spell fails, including untargeted modes; if some remain legal resolve as much as possible.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: One return target removed plus life modes; two returns with one removed.

requirements.claim: Create 2/2 all-color Citizens; proliferate chosen players/permanents with each existing counter kind; life mode gains four each time.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Repeated modes, multiple counter kinds, zero proliferate selections.

cards.name: Tatterkite
cards.selectionReason: Assignment risk sample across both batches; Tatterkite lower-complexity control

requirements.claim: Three-mana 2/1 artifact Scarecrow creature with flying.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Source reconciliation; flying native keyword.

requirements.claim: Cannot receive counters of any kind; another recipient in the same effect is still affected.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Multi-recipient counter effect changes other creature only.

requirements.claim: Cannot pay a cost requiring a counter be put on it; prohibited counter is not a prevented damage event.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Counter-placing activation cost rejected; wither event still occurs.

requirements.claim: Enters-with counters are prohibited, not entry itself; adding or proliferating counters cannot bypass prohibition.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Enters-with counter fixture; existing native counter checks.

cards.name: Ley Weaver
cards.selectionReason: Assignment risk sample across both batches; Tatterkite lower-complexity control

requirements.claim: Partner with Lore Weaver includes enters trigger targeting a player; targeted player may search their own library, reveal named card, put into their hand, then shuffle.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Opponent target controls optional decision and library search; decline does nothing.

requirements.claim: Search is optional, can fail to find, and must not find wrong card; reminder text does not remove reveal.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: No Lore Weaver present; nonmatching cards excluded.

requirements.claim: Tap is an activation cost; untap exactly two target lands (not just own), with target legality checked at resolution.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Opponent lands allowed; one removed leaves other untapped; nonland rejected.

requirements.claim: Partner construction keyword does not make this nonlegendary creature a legal commander.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Existing Commander eligibility remains false.

cards.name: Predatory Urge
cards.selectionReason: Assignment risk sample across both batches; Tatterkite lower-complexity control

requirements.claim: Aura enchants a creature; that creature, not the Aura controller, owns the granted tap activation.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Opponent-controlled host; only host controller can activate.

requirements.claim: Target a creature when activating; if it becomes illegal the entire ability fails.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Remove target in response; host takes no damage.

requirements.claim: Host deals its power first, then target deals its power to the same host; these are sequential damage operations, not fight.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Self-target produces two damage events; preserve the original host after Aura removal.

requirements.claim: If host leaves, its last-known power still deals damage; Aura leaving or moving cannot retarget the host binding.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Host removal and Aura removal responses.

cards.name: Hour of Promise
cards.selectionReason: Assignment risk sample across both batches; Tatterkite lower-complexity control

requirements.claim: Search own library for up to two land cards, including nonbasics; zero is legal; put them onto battlefield tapped then shuffle.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Decline to find; nonland excluded; choose one or two.

requirements.claim: Only after search, count all Deserts currently controlled; three or more creates exactly two black 2/2 Zombies.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: One existing plus two fetched reaches threshold; opponent Deserts do not count.

requirements.claim: Condition is evaluated at resolution after movement, not cast/activation time; not an intervening-if trigger.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Remove a Desert in response then fail threshold; fetched lands restore threshold.

cards.name: Sword of Truth and Justice
cards.selectionReason: Assignment risk sample across both batches; Tatterkite lower-complexity control

requirements.claim: Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and protection from white and blue; equip costs two and attaches only to own creature under equip timing.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Protection blocks white/blue targets and damage; stat changes follow attachment.

requirements.claim: Trigger requires equipped creature combat damage to a player, not ordinary damage or damage to a creature.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Negative noncombat damage; real combat positive.

requirements.claim: On resolution choose a creature you control without targeting, put one +1/+1 counter on it, then proliferate even if no creature remains.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Shroud/protection must not bar choice; remove only creature in response; proliferate still happens.

requirements.claim: New counter is available to proliferate; choice is mandatory when legal creature exists, proliferate selections optional.
requirements.adversarialQuestion: Choose creature with no counters then proliferate; choose zero proliferate objects.
